workspace.text:

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

- Monday 11:00-12:00: Priya is busy (Travel 11:00-11:30, Contract review 11:30-12:00)
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00: Priya is busy (Board prep 09:00-09:30, Partner lunch 09:30-10:00)
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00: Priya is busy (Client call 13:00-13:30, Client dinner prep 13:30-14:00)
- Thursday 09:30-10:00: Priya is busy (marked as Busy)
- Thursday 14:30-15:30: Priya is busy (Vendor meeting 14:30-15:00, Client dinner prep 15:00-15:30)
- Friday 15:00-16:00: Priya is busy (Hiring panel 15:00-15:30, Contract review 15:30-16:00)

There is no 30-minute slot next week where all four partners are simultaneously free. I will report this as infeasible.
